definitions.full: H4956. Misrephoth Mayim מַיִם מִשְׂרְפוֺת proper name, of a location names with Sidon Josh 11:8 ; 13:6 (apparently near coast); compare (dubious Buhl Geogr. 229 ) Mušêrfe , 14 miles south of Tyre, see Di and references, Guérin Gal ii. 166 f. . — Μασερων , Μασρεφωθμαειμ , etc. I. שׂרק (Late Hebrew סָרַק , Aramaic , סְרַק , all comb, card ; Arabic slit sheep's ear, pluck fruit).
definitions.rootNote: from the plural of 4955 and 4325 ; burnings of water ;

occurrences.englishText: Yahweh delivered them into the hand of Israel, and they struck them, and chased them to great Sidon, and to Misrephoth Maim, and to the valley of Mizpah eastward. They struck them until they left them no one remaining.

all the inhabitants of the hill country from Lebanon to Misrephoth Maim, even all the Sidonians. I will drive them out from before the children of Israel. Just allocate it to Israel for an inheritance, as I have commanded you.
